# OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER – RCRA TSD Operations Training

> Online initial HAZWOPER certification for workers at RCRA-permitted hazardous waste treatment, storage and disposal facilities (TSDFs). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulation: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(p)(7)(i) (general industry) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p)(7)(i) (construction)
- Duration: 24 hours; 64 lessons in 11 modules, ending with a final exam
- Credits: 2.4 CEU
- Price: $229.99 per person (online, self-paced). Bulk pricing from 2 seats.
- Other formats: SCORM package; virtual instructor-led ($399/person, minimum 10); client-site in-person ($1,095/person, minimum 10)
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months; plastic wallet card mailed within 2–3 weeks
- Prerequisites: none
- Renewal: OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher – RCRA TSD Operations (https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/8-hour-hazwoper-tsd-operations-p)

## Who it is for
TSDF hazardous waste workers; employees who handle, store or dispose of RCRA hazardous waste; EHS professionals; waste treatment and disposal workers; supervisors of hazardous waste facilities.

## Modules
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Medical Surveillance and Toxicology
3. Hazard Classification
4. Respiratory Protection
5. Personal Protective Equipment
6. HAZWOPER Site Operations
7. Material Sampling and Analysis
8. Confined Spaces and Excavations
9. Decontamination and Site Emergencies
10. EPA Cradle-to-Grave Program
11. Regulations for Specific Wastes
